Package com.bupt.ta.service.ai

Class AdminAnalyticsService

java.lang.Object
com.bupt.ta.service.ai.AdminAnalyticsService
public final class AdminAnalyticsService extends Object
Generates admin-facing platform analytics narrative from dashboard metrics.

Implements the AiFeatureNames.ADMIN_ANALYTICS feature. Converts an AdminDashboardMetrics snapshot into a factual user prompt via AdminMetricsBuilder.buildAnalyticsPrompt(com.bupt.ta.service.admin.AdminDashboardMetrics) and requests executive-style Markdown (trends, pipeline health, workload alerts, recommended actions).

Streaming entry point: AiStreamServlet with feature=adminAnalytics (Admin role only).
